verdict.rationale: Ashby publishes a developer API reference covering HTTP Basic Auth with API keys, cursor pagination, sync tokens for incremental application lists, and write endpoints such as candidate.create. It also documents signed webhooks and serves LLM-friendly docs (llms.txt and markdown versions of pages), so an AI-native user can both read and act through the API. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the standard paths probed (all 404), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API.
